title: NEB Class 11 Physics — Optics — 2022
subject: physics
source: NEB Grade 11 Model Questions / NEB Past Papers 2020-2024

questions.question: Differentiate between a real image and a virtual image.
questions.solution:
**Real image:** Formed when the reflected or refracted rays actually **converge** at a point.
- It can be obtained on a screen and is **inverted** (laterally inverted).
- Magnification $m = -\dfrac{v}{u}$ is negative.
- Formed by concave mirrors, convex lenses, and plane mirrors of object and image on the same side is not possible.
- $v$ and $u$ have opposite signs under Cartesian convention.

**Virtual image:** Formed when the reflected or refracted rays appear to **diverge** from a point and meet only on extension behind the mirror or lens.
- **Cannot** be obtained on a screen.
- Erect and same size as object for a plane mirror.
- Magnification is positive.
- $u$ and $v$ have the **same** sign.
questions.knowledgeNote: A real image is formed by actual convergence and is screenable; a virtual image only appears on ray extension.
